bil-01: Three-leaved, form of the three gunas, three-eyed, three weapons, destroying sins of three births — one bel leaf I offer to Shiva.
bil-02: With three-shooted, unpierced, tender auspicious bel leaves I shall worship Shiva.
bil-03: When Nandikeshvara is worshipped with an unbroken bel leaf, one is cleansed of all sins.
bil-04: Equal to offering a saligrama to the wise, equal to a soma-yajna — one bel to Shiva.
bil-05: Equal to thousands of crores of elephants, a hundred horse-sacrifices, a crore of kanya-dana — one bel to Shiva.
bil-06: Born of Lakshmi’s body, dear to Mahadeva — I offer the bel tree; one leaf to Shiva.
bil-07: Seeing and touching the bel tree destroys sin — one leaf to Shiva.
bil-08: Brahma at the root, Vishnu in the middle, Shiva at the tip — one bel leaf offered.
bil-09: Who recites this sacred ashtakam near Shiva attains Shiva-loka and rejoices with Shiva.
